correctness.rationale: The ordinary Prüfer sequence bijection yields the exact degree-conditioned occupancy representation. A common-prefix coupling and support obstruction prove the complete strict/incomparable stochastic phase diagram for all n>=5. A negative logarithmic derivative shows a unique degree-three mean sign crossing between n=8 and n=9, while a closed expression with finite rational endpoint checks handles higher degrees. The packaged stand-alone Python verifier passed 129 exact finite tests (n=5..7 full Prüfer words; means through 40). No unrestricted claim relies on the tests.
